name: Loan EMI Calculator
overview: Understand amortizing loan payments and total interest.
practice: Compare the same principal across rate and term assumptions.

name: Savings Planner
overview: Estimate saving goals using regular deposits and time horizons.
practice: Account for inflation and changes in interest rates.

name: Fixed Deposits
overview: Explore maturity value and compounding conventions.
practice: Verify institution terms, renewal and tax treatment.

name: Banking Fees
overview: Understand transaction, maintenance and transfer charges.
practice: Compare effective cost for your actual usage pattern.

name: Credit Card Interest
overview: Review interest periods, minimum payments and fee structures.
practice: Use the card agreement rather than a generic APR estimate.

name: Personal Budget
overview: Plan income allocation among essentials, goals and buffers.
practice: Track planned versus actual spending with consistent categories.

name: Stock Market Basics
overview: Understand equities, trading venues and market mechanics.
practice: Avoid treating price changes as guaranteed future returns.

name: Portfolio Diversification
overview: Explore correlation, concentration and rebalancing principles.
practice: Compare risk and time horizon across asset classes.

name: Forex & Currency
overview: Read exchange rates, spreads and settlement conventions.
practice: Distinguish mid-market reference rates from executed rates.

name: Gold & Silver
overview: Compare metal pricing, purity and retail premiums.
practice: Include taxes, storage and bid-ask spread in comparisons.

name: Inflation Calculator
overview: Understand purchasing power across periods.
practice: Use a named national index and baseline for comparisons.

name: Insurance Planning
overview: Compare coverage limits, exclusions and deductible trade-offs.
practice: Read official policy conditions before making decisions.

name: Business Break-even
overview: Calculate fixed-cost recovery from contribution margin.
practice: Validate selling price, variable expense and sales mix.

name: Profit Margin
overview: Distinguish markup, gross margin and net margin.
practice: Avoid mixing gross sales with tax-inclusive receipts.

name: Cash Flow Forecasting
overview: Plan cash inflows and outflows by timing.
practice: Consider receivable collection delays and working capital needs.

name: Invoice & Tax Concepts
overview: Understand line totals, adjustments and invoice documentation.
practice: Check jurisdiction-specific invoice and tax obligations.

name: Salary & Payroll
overview: Explore net-versus-gross pay and payroll deductions.
practice: Use current local rules for withholding and statutory benefits.

name: Small Business KPIs
overview: Understand revenue growth, customer economics and cash conversion.
practice: Compare metrics using consistent date and accounting definitions.

name: Import Cost
overview: Model product cost, transport, duties and clearance.
practice: Confirm HS classification and destination-country tax rates.

name: Export Pricing
overview: Estimate export profitability across currencies and shipping terms.
practice: Clarify responsibility under the relevant Incoterm.

name: Freight Cost
overview: Understand freight quotes, surcharges and service levels.
practice: Check fuel, terminal and documentation fees.

name: Container Capacity
overview: Estimate cubic-meter capacity and chargeable volume.
practice: Allow space for packaging and loading restrictions.

name: HS Codes
overview: Understand product classification and tariff nomenclature.
practice: Seek a binding ruling when customs classification is uncertain.

name: Customs Duties
overview: Review ad valorem rates, exemptions and calculation bases.
practice: Use the latest official customs tariff.

name: International Shipping
overview: Compare ocean, air and road shipping considerations.
practice: Match speed, insurance and risk to cargo needs.

name: Trade Documents
overview: Understand invoices, packing lists and shipment paperwork.
practice: Confirm country, product and carrier requirements.

name: Global GDP
overview: Interpret gross domestic product and growth data.
practice: Differentiate nominal from inflation-adjusted figures.

name: Interest Rates
overview: Understand central-bank policy rates and lending benchmarks.
practice: Look at the rate effective date and market transmission lag.

name: Economic Indicators
overview: Explore unemployment, inflation, trade and growth measures.
practice: Check definitions and seasonality before comparing countries.

name: Business News
overview: Track verifiable policy, market and company announcements.
practice: Prefer official filings and date-stamped reputable reporting.
